question.text: A solid sphere is in pure rolling motion on an inclined surface having inclination $\theta$.

options.text: frictional force acting on sphere is $f=\mu m g \cos \theta$
friction will increase its angular velocity and decreases its linear velocity

solution.text:
In case of pure rolling,
$$
\begin{aligned}
& f=\frac{m g \sin \theta}{1+\frac{m R^2}{I}} \\
\therefore & f \propto \sin \theta
\end{aligned}
$$
(upwards)
Therefore, as $\theta$ decreases force of friction will also decrease.
